mapper.sql: id, region_name, region_code, fee_period, rel_fee_period, person_count, avg_age, avg_payment_base, avg_payment_amount, generate_time, create_time, update_time, remark, valid_status
mapper.select: SELECT fee_period, AVG(person_count) AS avg_person_count FROM insured_summary_by_region WHERE fee_period BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND valid_status = 1 GROUP BY fee_period ORDER BY fee_period ASC

SELECT fee_period, AVG(avg_payment_amount) AS avg_payment_amount_count FROM insured_summary_by_region WHERE fee_period BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND valid_status = 1 GROUP BY fee_period ORDER BY fee_period ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN avg_age < 20 THEN '20岁以下' WHEN avg_age >= 20 AND avg_age < 25 THEN '20-24岁' WHEN avg_age >= 25 AND avg_age < 28 THEN '25-27岁' WHEN avg_age >= 28 AND avg_age < 30 THEN '28-29岁' ELSE '30岁以上' END AS age_group, COUNT(*) AS person_count FROM insured_summary_by_region WHERE fee_period BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND valid_status = 1 GROUP BY CASE WHEN avg_age < 20 THEN '20岁以下' WHEN avg_age >= 20 AND avg_age < 25 THEN '20-24岁' WHEN avg_age >= 25 AND avg_age < 28 THEN '25-27岁' WHEN avg_age >= 28 AND avg_age < 30 THEN '28-29岁' ELSE '30岁以上' END ORDER BY CASE age_group WHEN '20岁以下' THEN 1 WHEN '20-24岁' THEN 2 WHEN '25-27岁' THEN 3 WHEN '28-29岁' THEN 4 WHEN '30岁以上' THEN 5 END
